skill_updates.change: before the first push of a round branch, extract the target repository's own governed write-set classifier (the ALLOWED/DENIED regexes and the declared BASE) and run it against `git diff --name-only BASE...HEAD`. Reproducing a red gate locally is cheaper than discovering it from a check-run, and it means the reviewer learns the round's scope from the round.

keep the round's evidence packet on a dedicated evidence branch, not on the product branch: a governed write set should equal the product change. When an allowance genuinely must widen for a file the work order names, do it as ONE named line plus a disclosure, never a prefix.

before filing or fixing a control-plane inconsistency, read the declaration that created it (`declared_by`, registry `status`). A pool ordering recorded as OWNER_ORDERED_IN_FORCE is owner policy: obtain the arm you need by identity and record the divergence; do not edit the plane.

classify every checker NOT_RUN as subject-property vs harness-capability, and close the harness ones inside the contract (escalated sandbox + guard root) before accepting a bounded verdict. Also re-run a new guard against the PRE-REPAIR tree: mutation cases only prove the check can fail, not that it would have caught the defect.
